title: Practice Tab
description: Practice Tab documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers practice tab workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Review Primary Contact & Program Dates
subtasks.purpose: Read the practice’s contact details and the active CCM / RPM program windows.

steps.title: Confirm Practice Tab
steps.description: On the practice landing page, ensure the Practice tab is selected (highlighted dark navy).

steps.title: Read Primary Contact
steps.description: Read the Primary Contact card: Facility, Email, Phone 1, Phone 2, Fax and the Status pill (Active shown in green).

steps.title: Read Program Dates
steps.description: Read the Program Dates table for each enrolled program (CCM / RPM) with Start date, End date and the derived Days remaining in the billing window. Notes Practice contact details are managed by Super Admin / System Admin; Practice Admin has read-only view here. A red Status pill (Inactive) blocks new device orders, uploads and billing until reactivated.

subtasks.title: Review Monitoring Details
subtasks.purpose: Confirm how eVitals is monitoring this practice and how devices are supplied.

steps.title: Scroll to Monitoring Details
steps.description: Scroll below Primary Contact to the Monitoring Details card.

steps.title: Read Monitoring Flags
steps.description: Read each flag (Yes / No). Notes Buying Device = Yes means the practice purchases devices outright; No means eVitals leases devices for the program. Changes to these flags must be raised with Super Admin / System Admin. Task 7.3 — Admins Tab
